ja284:1.1: Yaṃ ussukā saṃgharanti alakkhikā bahuṃ dhanaṃ sippavanto asippā ca Lakkhī va tāni bhuñjati.
ja284:2.1: Sabbattha katapuññassa atīv' aññe va pāṇino uppajjanti bahū bhogā app-anāyatanesu pīti.
ja284:3.1: Kukkuṭamaṇayo daṇḍo thiyo ca {puññalakkhaṇā} uppajjanti apāpassa katapuññassa jantuno ti
